review_scope: Five dispersed complete dialogues plus eight domain-covering dialogues (one overlap), read by root; not a whole-pool semantic review.

finding.positive: Most sampled replies preserved corrections, retained the unchanged fact and gave useful conditional advice without pretending to execute tools.

formatting_concern.detail: Drafting turn uses a single-paragraph draft followed by a separate explanation despite the active one-paragraph format; exclude pending explicit format review.

finding.closed_values: Every seeded field has only3–4 possible values across2253 candidates; quantity exaggerates semantic diversity.

decision: Do not bulk-admit. Expand value coverage and check intermediate-response constraints. Keep these candidates distinct from trained data.
